description: Apache Tomcat is an open-source implementation of the Java Servlet, JavaServer Pages, Java Expression Language and WebSocket technologies.
common_risks: Remote Code Execution via Manager application
real_world_incidents: Widespread exploitation of default manager credentials to deploy web shells.

audience_guidance.student: Tomcat runs Java web apps. If you leave the admin panel open with default passwords, anyone can upload a virus.
audience_guidance.developer: Remove the default manager application if not needed in production. Secure the AJP connector.
audience_guidance.bug_bounty_hunter: Check for /manager/html, try default credentials like tomcat:tomcat, admin:admin.
audience_guidance.pentester: If manager access is achieved, generate a malicious WAR payload using msfvenom and deploy it for a reverse shell.
audience_guidance.security_team: Monitor for WAR file deployments and enforce strong access controls on administrative interfaces.
